content.title: 8 Spring Nail Polish Colors That Will Make Your Manicure Bloom
content.text: If you click on links we provide, we may receive compensation. Published on March 21, 2026 06:45AM @thenaillologist / Instagram We can all agree that there's nothing quite as revitalizing as the start of spring after a long, cold winter. And it's only natural to celebrate the invigorating seasonal shift, whether with your clothes, your hair, or your nails. Speaking of: We chatted with a few nail experts to determine the most popular nail polish colors for spring 2026. "Sheer, barely-there colored nails have been trending," says Le Mini Macaron CEO and co-founder Christina Kao. "This minimalist trend works beautifully on short and long nails, offering versatility to suit any style." Meet the Experts Christina Kao is the co-founder and CEO of Le Mini Macaron. Jenifer Guevara is a lead nail technician with nailsaloon. Olivia Van Iderstine is a mani trend expert and vice president of content for Olive & June. Of course, pastels are in, too. "Pastel shades gently remind us that spring is on its way," says nailsaloon lead nail technician Jenifer Guevara. "It's such an inspiring vibe, perfect for refreshing our spirits as the season changes." This year, brighter pops of color are welcome, too—so if you've been craving a hot pink or bright blue mani, there's no need to wait until summer. Ready to start planning your upcoming warm-weather manicures? Ahead, explore the top eight nail polish colors for spring. 01 of 08 All Things Pink @phoebesummernails / Instagram "Pink is the heartbeat of spring, soft as new blossoms, vibrant as fresh beginnings, and a reminder that warmth and renewal are just around the corner," Guevara says. "Barbie pink brings bold energy to spring and is vibrant, playful, and full of life. Elegant sheer pink nails are perfect for spring—they offer a delicate, refined look, and a fresh hue that brightens your style. Meanwhile, light baby pink captures the heart of spring that is fresh, delicate, and full of promise." When selecting your perfect pink mani shade, Olive & June's mani trend expert and vice president of content, Olivia Van Iderstine, says to consider sheer coats of color. "For spring, it's all about a tutu vibe," she says, adding that her go-tos are Olive & June's CCT Gel and Strawberry Scone Polish. "Look for a sheer wash of pink or blush, almost like your nails are wearing some tulle. This neutral will look so elegant—plus, a sheer always hides growth and imperfections beautifully." If you prefer bolder manicures, however, Van Iderstine encourages embracing a bright pink nail look. "Some like it hot pink," she says; Olive & June's Diner Date Polish and XOXO Gel are two of her top picks. "If you're not a pastel person, this bright hue is perfect for you. Look for shades with a lot of red in the formula, so it feels tropical without feeling too precious." At the end of the day, all shades of pink are permitted for spring. "Whether sheer and natural or creamy and opaque, pink brings an effortlessly fresh and feminine touch to any manicure," says Kao. 02 of 08 Butter Yellow @lolo.nailedit / instagram Whether you're dreaming of sunny days or drawing inspo from Timothée Chalamet's statement-making Oscars suit, a butter-yellow manicure will fit the vibe. "The pastel sunny hue is back again this spring, because it's a guaranteed pick me up," Van Iderstine says. "If you're afraid of yellow, don't be! Try it as a French tip to start, but we truly love an all-out, short sunny mani all season long." Kao agrees: "Nothing says spring quite like a soft, buttery yellow," she says, noting that Le Mini Macaron's Chamomile and Vanilla Milk Gel Polishes are perfect selections for that pale, creamy yellow hue. 03 of 08 Light Minty Green @heluviee / instagram Green is the color of growth, making it the perfect manicure shade for spring. Not all shades of green reign supreme, though. "Sweet and refreshing mint, please," Van Iderstine requests (and suggests). She says, "A soft green has that sweet mint gum flavor that's so spring. And don't be intimidated by greens! With so much white pigment, a pastel makes this fun hue super wearable." Kao also thinks light green polish is a must for spring. "Pistachio and matcha tones are making their mark, bringing a fresh and unexpected twist to classic pastels," she reveals. 04 of 08 Bright Grassy Green @thenaillologist / Instagram Grassy green is also on trend. "The grass is always greener on your manis," Van Iderstine jokes. "Time to ditch the winter blahs for greener pastures with grassy green shades of moss or glowy emerald." 05 of 08 Something Blue @lolo.nailedit / instagram While only a few shades of green are suggested for spring, the experts we spoke with confirmed that basically every shade of blue is wearable and welcome. "It may be warming up, but a pale icy blue is so on trend for spring," Van Iderstine says, noting that Olive & June's BP Gel is a fab option. "This is one of our go-to unexpected neutrals that still work in every setting." She also loves denim blue this season: "This trend is our favorite fashion moment for manis, and it's all about finding your personal style," she explains. (Try Olive & June's CNH Polish and Vintage Gel.) "Take this trend and make it your own, just like your favorite pair of jeans. It can be deeper, brighter, or softer and more faded." Meanwhile, Guevara says that cool aqua and sky blue nails are popular requests at her salon. "A cool, calming aqua shade teases beach weather and matches the season's uplifting energy," she says. "And sky blue nails capture the essence of a clear, crisp spring day. Their light, cool hue evokes the serene beauty of a bright sky." But don't be afraid to go bright, either. "As a rising trend in both fashion and interior design, electric blue has made its mark in bold accents and statement pieces," Kao says, noting that Le Mini Macaron's Mariniere Gel Polish and Blue Raspberry Gel Polish fit the bill. "It's a power color." 06 of 08 Not Quite White Lights Lacquer You can wear white nails whenever you'd like, but this spring, Guevara says not-quite-white shades are the move. "Almost white nails mean simplicity and sophistication," she tells us. "They capture the clean, bright energy of spring." They also look undeniably chic. "With the rise of 'quiet luxury,' which champions subtlety and elegance over maximalism, these neutral hues have become synonymous with refined taste and very much on trend," adds Kao of the creamy, off-white hues. 07 of 08 Soft Camel Gelcare For a true neutral nail color, Guevara suggests reaching for camel-toned polishes. "Camel colors are perfect for every occasion and go with just about everything," she explains. 08 of 08 Greige Manucurist Meanwhile, if you're not quite ready for a bright and sunny nail look, Van Iderstine says greige is the perfect transitional tone. "One of our favorite March neutrals is a 'greige' AKA a grey-beige," she shares. "This shade stops people in their tracks—is it grey? Is it beige? Is that a hint of pink? It's sophisticated, plays well with everything, and looks good on everyone."
